issues.evidence: Capacity not guaranteed and 8 below expected waiting loss do not establish B. If reserve can handle failure 99% of the time, p=.5, and in the other 1% the order is lost, D costs 3+.5*(.99*4+.01*30)=5.13 versus B=8 and A=15.
issues.minimalFix: Make reserved capacity unavailable for the required order, or explicitly compare total expected cost including residual damage against both reservation and waiting.
issues.retest: Whole-option B counterfactual and unchanged A/C/D.

issues.evidence: Suppose the first technical layer alone releases all 36 in 7 weeks. Its 36/7 beats 20/4, yet the existing catalog/neighbor/extension plan remains available. Weighted completion cost B→neighbor = 36*7+20*11=472, compared with C = 24*4+20*8+12*16=448. The condition omits the actual competing vertical path.
issues.minimalFix: Specify, for example, that a first independently releasable layer brings all 36 within four weeks, followed by portfolio reranking. Then direct layer is at least as fast as catalog and brings greater value.
issues.retest: Check changed WHEN against both alternative integrations and competing work.

caseEvidence.TC-117: A=30p, B=8, C=3+30p because withdrawing the oldest batch always greens dashboard, D=3+4p. D is uniquely cheapest throughout [.4,.6]. Senior must separate signals before vs after a mitigation that changes the sample, and buy time to use fresh independent evidence. §2.6 supports EWI, staged mitigation and expected-loss economics. ALLOWED REINFORCEMENT with TC-211 (unchanged informative early signal; late proof unavailable), TC-294 (forecast revision), TC-104/105 (reaction lead time) and TC-008 (causal attribution rather than evidence for withdrawing a live protection).
caseEvidence.TC-118: Catalog 24/(3+1)=6, neighbor 20/4=5, extension (36-24)/8=1.5. A ranks indivisible original; B double counts unavailable value; D delays higher marginal value. Senior restructures the investment while charging prerequisite once and separating independently realizable benefits. §9.3 marketplace example directly links scope and ranking. ALLOWED REINFORCEMENT with TC-051–053, which merge inseparable P/K with duplicate orders and change insertion/preemption across a fixed acceptance bottleneck. TC-118 instead decomposes a single opportunity and interposes other work.
caseEvidence.TC-119: K7/P1 green fails after semantic change in P2. B races new artifacts between retest and release; C preserves pair identity but takes four hours versus 30 minutes and blocks unrelated consumer. D checks semantic behavior and actual pair before admission in eight minutes. The blind runner-up B privileges throughput; scoring C .7 versus B .6 defensible because C preserves safety. §3.2 explicitly requires tests on the current API and notification on contract changes. Senior designs evidence validity across independent pipelines. ALLOWED REINFORCEMENT with TC-047 (flaky checker/manual confirmation) and TC-197 (missing criterion/unaudited exception). A/B/C WHEN alternatives respectively guarantee semantic invariance, fix both builds until release, or remove scope knowledge and permit full regression. No significant teaching defect.
